bus.via: El Cerrito Del Norte Station to Redwood Park n Ride

trips.route_note: Take the Vallejo ferry or BART to El Cerrito, then a bus or the Napa Valley Vine line into Napa; most visitors use a wine-tour shuttle for the last leg.
trips.tour_query: Napa Valley wine tour from San Francisco
trips.why: Public transit takes over 2.5 hours with a ferry/BART-plus-bus transfer and a last-mile problem to the wineries, so a wine-tour shuttle is the practical choice.
know: Book wine-tour shuttles ahead, especially on weekends
Most wineries require reservations for tastings
Harvest season (late summer to fall) is the most popular time to visit
